newsitem.title: JAPAN: Short-term rates moving below Japan ODR-BOJ quoted.
newsitem.headline: Short-term rates moving below Japan ODR-BOJ quoted.

text.p: Japan's short-term interest rates and overnight call rate are generally moving somewhat below the level of the official discount rate, Bank of Japan (BOJ) vice governor Toshihiko Fukui was quoted as saying on Tuesday.
His remarks were relayed to reporters by Economic Planning Agency Minister Taro Aso.
Fukui also said that long-term interest rates were moving in low ranges and that lending rates continued to be at their lowest levels ever.

Fukui was also quoted as saying that Tokyo stocks had fallen sharply since the beginning of the year and that foreign exchange, while fluctuating somewhat, was moving in the direction of a weaker yen.
Money supply was showing growth of around 3.5 percent, Aso quoted the BOJ vice governor as telling a cabinet meeting on Tuesday.
